input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research track 21 draw: open a water-leak programme on the real BattLeDIM data and land step 1
errors: First D1 version held off g days after an alarm; a unit test showed the same leak re-alarms when the hold-off ends (window had no post-leak data). Fixed with re-anchoring; the first, flawed run had already printed 2019 numbers (disclosed in LOG.md).
First run gave the four leaks carried from 2018 a false 2019-01-01 onset; fixed by merging both years' events.
First chance-level sampler used rejection sampling for spaced alarm sets, which would almost never accept at 14-day spacing; replaced with exact sampling over spaced sets.
README per-leak bullet first quoted delays from the pre-fix run (p827 +17 h); corrected to the final results (+146 h) before commit.
integrity_issues: 2019 test results were seen once before the re-anchoring design change; disclosed in LOG.md and README Limitations. The new parameter (7-day minimum window) was set once, not tuned on 2019.
2018 leak labels were used for tuning, which BattLeDIM competitors did not have; disclosed wherever published figures are quoted.
Vrachimis et al. 2022 is paywalled and was not opened; its results are quoted via Melnikov 2025 Table 2 and labelled so.

doc_friction.issue: Track 21 milestone 3 still says BattLeDIM is unreachable from the proxy; on 2026-11-12 zenodo.org/api/records/4017659 served every file (raw.githubusercontent too; github.com HTML 403). Worth re-probing hosts listed as blocked.
It sent the draw to track 21 and said open a programme, but did not mention that a sibling PR (#15239, grid-linopf) had opened an infra programme 30 minutes earlier; found only by listing open PRs.

deviations.why: Pre-registered detector design (g-day hold-off) was buggy; changed it after a first look at 2019
deviations.did: re-anchored the training window after each alarm, logged the change and the look
deviations.result: 13/19 with 2 FP instead of 12/19 with 4 FP; the headline (near chance on counts, above chance on location) holds under both

goal: Open a PhD-level programme on a real industrial benchmark (water networks) and land a first, chance-corrected result
notes: Local checks: water-leaks pytest 9 passed; research/_homepage/build.py ok (1075 projects); programme_check ok; check_md_links ok; cite_check 14/14 ok; research_live_links ok. Headline: D1-F on BattLeDIM 2019 detects 13/19 new leaks with 2 FP; random alarms with the same count: median 11 (8-13), P=0.105; alarming sensor within 300 m along pipes 5 vs chance 0 (P<0.001). No agent doc in docs/reports: the LOG.md and PROPOSAL.md milestones carry the next step.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a researcher reading the benchmark and 3 papers, writing loader, harness, detector, null and proposal

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
